title: A Fresh Start.
description: The base game, if "no" was never an answer.
body:
This modpack adds features that feel like they should already be part of Minecraft.
Pure quality-of-life improvements, visual polish, and small tweaks that make the game smoother, clearer, and more enjoyable — without changing what Minecraft _is_.
Everything is designed to feel **vanilla-adjacent**, **familiar**, **intuitive**, and easy to forget isn’t official.
## What to expect
- **Quality-of-life** improvements that remove long-standing friction and annoyances
- **Visual enhancements** that improve clarity and atmosphere while respecting the vanilla art style
- **Subtle tweaks** that feel necessary, obvious, and overdue
- No new progression systems, no feature bloat, no overdesign
## What this is _not_
- Not a total overhaul
- Not a content-heavy modpack
- Not a departure from vanilla gameplay
Just Minecraft — **slightly more complete**
For the intended experience, keep the included resource packs in their default order; some are not fully updated for the latest version and may have minor issues. Turning on shaders will affect certain texture packs like "Vibrant Fog" and "Story Mode Clouds"
